messages.content: Hi, I think I left my debit card at a gas station last night. I don't see any weird charges yet but I'm nervous. Can you shut it off?

Thank you for contacting Elmstead Credit. Before we take any action on your account, please complete our 3-point identity check: the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth, and the 6-digit one-time passcode we will text to the phone on file. Once verified, you can freeze the card immediately in Elmstead Online or the app under Cards > CardGuard > Freeze; the freeze takes effect right away and can be reversed if the card turns up. If you confirm the card is lost, we will close it and reissue a card with a new number, delivered free in 7–10 business days or in 2 business days for a $15 expedited fee. Our CardGuard line at 555-0142 is available 24/7 if you prefer to report it by phone.
My paycheck direct deposit hit yesterday but my available balance is way lower than it should be. Says there's an ACH hold?? Never had this before. I just started a new job

Thank you for reaching out, and congratulations on the new position. For your security, please first verify your identity with the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth, and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file. Once verified, we can review the deposit. As general information, an incoming ACH deposit over $5,000 from an employer or originator we have not seen before is placed on a 2-business-day ACH hold; deposits from that originator afterward are normally not held. We will confirm the exact release date for your deposit as soon as verification is complete.
Locked out of Elmstead Online again. I typed my password wrong a few times this morning and now it says call you. I'm at work, can't call until lunch.

We are sorry for the inconvenience. Five failed sign-in attempts lock Elmstead Online for 30 minutes; because this is a second lockout within 24 hours, a reset must be completed by phone with the Member Service Center at 555-0118 after our 3-point identity check (last 4 of your member number, date of birth, and the one-time passcode texted to your phone on file). We are open until 8:00 p.m. Central Time today, so a call at lunch or after work is fine. Please never share your password with anyone, including Elmstead staff; we will never ask for it.
Can you tell me what the hours are for the Bellmere branch on Saturday? Want to drop off some paperwork for my auto loan.

Thank you for your question. The Bellmere branch is closed on Saturdays. On Saturdays from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. Central Time you may visit Harrow Falls Main, Linden Square or Quarry Road instead. If your auto loan paperwork contains account details, please hand it directly to a member service representative and bring a government-issued photo ID so we can verify your identity before accepting the documents.
There's a charge on my card from some online store for $214.60 that I definately didn't make. What do I do

Thank you for letting us know. Before we discuss any transaction, please complete identity verification: the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth, and the 6-digit passcode we will send to your phone on file. Once you are verified, we recommend freezing the card right away in Elmstead Online under Cards > CardGuard > Freeze, then filing form DS-2 under Help > Dispute a Transaction. Disputes must be filed within 60 days of the statement date. After we receive a complete dispute, dispute provisional credit posts within 10 business days while our Fraud & Disputes team investigates for up to 45 calendar days.
hello I want to turn on that round up thing my sister has. how does it work and is it free

Thank you for your interest in Round-Up Savings. The feature is free: each debit card purchase on your share draft is rounded up to the next dollar, and the round-ups are swept to your Primary Share each night. In your first year, Elmstead Credit adds a 10% match, capped at $100, paid on your enrollment anniversary. To enroll, sign in to Elmstead Online and open Savings > Round-Up; if you would like us to enroll you by phone, we will first verify your identity with the last 4 of your member number, your date of birth and a one-time passcode.
I'm traveling to Portugal and Spain next month for 2 weeks. Do I need to call you guys so my card works?

Thank you for planning ahead. A call is not necessary: CardGuard Travel Mode replaces travel notices. In Elmstead Online or the app, go to Cards > CardGuard > Travel Mode, enter your travel dates, and select Portugal and Spain. You will need to be signed in, which completes your identity verification. Please also save our 24/7 CardGuard line, 555-0142, in case your card is lost or declined while abroad. Note that disputes on foreign transactions may take up to 90 days to investigate, so please review your activity promptly after your trip.
Hi, I'm paying off my car loan early. Need a payoff amount please. Thanks, Gerald

Thank you, Gerald. Before we can release any loan information, please complete our 3-point identity check: the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth, and the one-time passcode we will text to the phone on file. Once verified, we will issue a payoff quote, which is valid for 10 days. After the loan is paid in full, the lien is released within 10 business days in electronic title states, and paper titles are mailed within 15 business days.
Why was I charged $28 three times on Tuesday?!? This is ridiculous, I only went over by like 6 dollars

We understand your frustration, and we would like to review this with you. For your security, please first verify your identity using the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth, and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file. As general information, Courtesy Pay charges $28 per item that overdraws the share draft, with a maximum of 3 fees per day. Once you are verified, we can review the items from Tuesday with you and discuss enrolling in Overdraft Transfer, which moves funds from your savings for a $5 fee instead.
my mobile deposit for a $3,200 check only made $225 available. when do I get the rest

Thank you for your message. To discuss a specific deposit, we first need to verify your identity: please provide the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth, and the one-time passcode we will text to your phone on file. For mobile check deposits, the first $225 is available the next business day and the remainder within 2 business days, provided the deposit was submitted before the 6:00 p.m. Central Time cutoff. Once verified, we will confirm the expected availability date for your check.
I got a text saying my Elmstead account was suspended and to click a link and enter my card number and PIN. Is this you??

Thank you for checking with us before responding. That message did not come from Elmstead Credit. We never ask for your full card number, PIN, online banking password or full member number by text, email or chat. Please do not click the link. If you already entered any information, call our CardGuard line at 555-0142 immediately (available 24/7); after a 3-point identity check we will freeze your card, reset your Elmstead Online credentials and escalate to our Fraud & Disputes team.
Could you please change my auto loan due date from the 1st to the 15th? My pay schedule changed.

Thank you for your request. Before we make any change to your loan, please verify your identity with the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth, and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file. Elmstead Auto Loans allows the due date to be changed once every 12 months. Once you are verified, we will confirm your eligibility and process the change to the 15th.
What's the difference between the Everyday and the Summit checking? Thinking about switching.

Thank you for your question. Our checking accounts are called share drafts. Everyday Share Draft has no monthly fee. Summit Share Draft is $8 per month, waived with a $2,500 average daily balance or $1,000 or more in monthly direct deposit, and includes free expedited replacement cards and 4 out-of-network ATM fee refunds per month. If you decide to switch, we will verify your identity with the 3-point check before making any change to your account.
Hi I sent money to my roommate with QuickPay but typed the wrong phone number. $400. Can you get it back??

Thank you for contacting us promptly. Before we can look into the payment, please complete identity verification: the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth, and the one-time passcode we will text to your phone on file. Once verified, we will check whether the Elmstead QuickPay payment is still pending and can be cancelled. If it has already been claimed, we will open a request with our Fraud & Disputes team to attempt recovery, although recovery of a payment sent to an unintended recipient cannot be guaranteed.
I need to send a wire to my title company today for a house closing. What's the cutoff and fee?

Thank you for your message, and congratulations on your closing. Outgoing domestic wires cost $20 and must be submitted by 2:00 p.m. Central Time to go out the same business day. Because this is likely a first-time recipient, we will also complete a call-back verification before release. Please begin with our 3-point identity check (last 4 of your member number, date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file). We also recommend confirming the title company's wire instructions by phone using a number you already know, as closing-related wire fraud is common.
I froze my card in the app but my streaming subscription still went through this morning. I thought freezing stopped everything?

Thank you for your question. A CardGuard card freeze blocks new purchases and ATM withdrawals, but by design it still allows refunds and charges from recurring merchants you had already authorized, so that bills are not interrupted. If you do not recognize the subscription, or you want it stopped, please verify your identity first with the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file. Once verified, we can discuss a dispute or, if the card is lost, closing and reissuing it with a new number.
Hi there. I changed my cell number two weeks ago and now I can't get the passcode texts. How do I verify?

Thank you for letting us know. Because the phone number on file changed within the last 30 days, we are unable to verify you by text passcode. For your security, please verify in person at any Elmstead Credit branch with a government-issued photo ID, or schedule a VerifyLive video call through the Member Service Center at 555-0118 (Mon–Fri 7:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m., Sat 9:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m. CT). Once verified, we can assist with your request.
Need to stop payment on share draft #1043, I wrote it to a contractor who never showed up. Is there a fee

Thank you for contacting us. A stop payment on a share draft carries a $30 fee. Before we place it, please complete our 3-point identity check: the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth, and the one-time passcode we will text to your phone on file. Once verified, we will confirm that share draft #1043 has not yet cleared and place the stop payment.
what rate would I get on a 2017 used SUV? 60 months

Thank you for your interest in Elmstead Auto Loans. Our used vehicle rates, starting at 6.19% APR for terms up to 66 months, apply to model year 2019 or newer, so a 2017 vehicle does not qualify for this program. Our Lending support team can review other options with you; to discuss your specific situation or credit, we will first verify your identity with the last 4 of your member number, your date of birth and a one-time passcode.
Filed a dispute on Sept 22 for a $89 charge. It's been 2 weeks and no provisional credit. What's going on

Thank you for following up. Before we can review the status of your dispute, please verify your identity with the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth, and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file. Dispute provisional credit posts within 10 business days after we receive a complete dispute, so if form DS-2 was missing any information the clock may have started later. Once verified, we will confirm whether your dispute is complete and escalate to our Fraud & Disputes team if the provisional credit is overdue.
Card got damaged (snapped in half lol). I have Summit checking - do I have to pay for fast shipping?

Thank you for your message. Summit Share Draft members receive expedited replacement cards free of charge, delivered in 2 business days; the $15 expedited fee is waived. Before we order the replacement, please complete our 3-point identity check: the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth, and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file. Because the card was damaged rather than lost, we can reissue it with the same card number if you prefer.
Do I need an appointment for a notary? I need my power of attorney form notarized.

Thank you for your question. Notary services are available only at our Harrow Falls Main branch (210 Orchard Ave), by appointment. You may schedule by calling the Member Service Center at 555-0118. Please bring a government-issued photo ID; all signers must be present, and we will verify your membership before the appointment.
My car payment is 4 days late, the money was stuck. Will I get hit with a late fee?

Thank you for letting us know. Elmstead Auto Loans has a 10-day payment grace period, after which a $25 late fee applies, so a payment received within the grace period will not incur the fee. To review your loan and confirm the exact grace period end date, please first verify your identity with the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file.
Trying to move $12,000 from my Elmstead savings to my brokerage at another bank and it won't let me. Error says limit exceeded.

Thank you for your message. External transfers in Elmstead Online are limited to $10,000 per day, which is why the $12,000 transfer was declined. You may send $10,000 today and the remainder the next day, or send an outgoing domestic wire ($20 fee, 2:00 p.m. CT cutoff). For a wire, we will first verify your identity with our 3-point check: the last 4 of your member number, your date of birth and a one-time passcode texted to your phone on file.
sent a secure message monday about my statement, no answer yet

Thank you for your patience, and we apologize for the delay. Secure messages in Elmstead Online are normally answered within 8 business hours, so your message is overdue. We have flagged it for the Member Service Center manager. If you would like help sooner, please call 555-0118 during service hours; we will begin with a brief identity verification before discussing your statement.
There's a charge from June on my card I don't recognize, $45. Just noticed it. Can I still dispute?

Thank you for reviewing your account. Disputes must be filed within 60 days of the statement date on which the charge first appeared, so a June charge may be outside the dispute window. Please verify your identity first (last 4 of your member number, date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file) so we can check the statement date. If the charge appears to be fraud, our Fraud & Disputes team will still review it, and we recommend freezing the card in CardGuard in the meantime.
Do you refund ATM fees? I used one at the airport and got charged $4.50

Thank you for your question. Summit Share Draft members receive refunds for up to 4 out-of-network ATM fees per month; Everyday Share Draft does not include ATM fee refunds. To check which account you hold and whether the refund applies, please verify your identity with the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode texted to your phone on file.
Hi! Trying to deposit a $6,000 check through the app and it keeps rejecting it. Is something wrong with my account?

Thank you for your message. Nothing appears to be wrong; mobile check deposits are limited to $5,000 per day and $15,000 per rolling 30 days, so a $6,000 check exceeds the daily limit. You may deposit it at any Elmstead Credit branch, where a representative will verify your identity with a photo ID before accepting the check. If you have further questions about your account, we will begin with our 3-point identity check.
Is GAP insurance worth it? The dealer wants like $900 for it. Do you offer it on your loans?

Thank you for your question. Elmstead Auto Loans offers GAP coverage for a one-time $395. We are not able to advise whether it is right for you, but GAP generally covers the difference between your loan balance and the vehicle's value if it is totaled or stolen. If you would like to add GAP to an existing Elmstead loan, our Lending support team will first verify your identity with the last 4 of your member number, your date of birth and a one-time passcode.
I want to close my account and move to a different bank. What do I need to do?

Thank you for being an Elmstead Credit member, and we are sorry to see you go. To close your membership, please first complete our 3-point identity check: the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode texted to your phone on file. Once verified, we will confirm that no share drafts, automatic payments or loans remain outstanding. Your $5 membership share in the Primary Share is returned when the membership is closed. You may also close your account in person at any branch with a photo ID.
I got an email that my Elmstead Online password was changed but I didn't change it. Now I can't log in. HELP

Thank you for alerting us right away; we are treating this as a possible account takeover. Please call our CardGuard 24/7 fraud line at 555-0142 now. After a 3-point identity check (last 4 of your member number, date of birth, and a one-time passcode sent to your phone on file), we will immediately freeze your cards, reset your Elmstead Online credentials and escalate the case to our Fraud & Disputes team. Please do not reply to the email or use any link in it.
How do I pause round ups for a couple months? Money's tight right now.

Thank you for your message. You can pause Round-Up Savings at any time in Elmstead Online under Savings > Round-Up, and resume it from the same screen whenever you are ready; signing in completes your identity verification. Round-ups already swept to your Primary Share stay in your savings. Please note that pausing does not extend the first-year 10% match period, which is paid on your enrollment anniversary.
When does the round up match actually get paid? Its been 8 months and I haven't seen anything

Thank you for your question. The first-year Round-Up Savings match is 10% of your round-ups, capped at $100, and it is paid once, on your enrollment anniversary, rather than monthly. If you enrolled 8 months ago, the match will be credited in about 4 months. To confirm your exact enrollment date, please verify your identity with the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file.
My card was declined at a restaurant in Lisbon even though I set travel mode. Embarrassing. Fix it please

We apologize for the inconvenience during your trip. For your security, please first complete our 3-point identity check: the last 4 of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode texted to your phone on file. If text messages are not reaching you abroad, please call the CardGuard 24/7 line at 555-0142. Once verified, we will confirm that Portugal and your travel dates are correctly set in CardGuard Travel Mode and check whether the card was frozen or the decline came from a fraud rule.
I was charged the $8 Summit fee but I have direct deposit from my job every two weeks?

Thank you for reaching out. The $8 monthly Summit Share Draft fee is waived with $1,000 or more in direct deposits during the month or a $2,500 average daily balance. Before we review your deposits, please verify your identity using the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file. If your direct deposits met the threshold, we will reverse the fee.
found my card in my jacket pocket lol. how do I unfreeze

We are glad you found it. To unfreeze your card, sign in to Elmstead Online or the app and go to Cards > CardGuard, then select Unfreeze; the change takes effect immediately. Signing in serves as your identity verification. If you notice any transactions you do not recognize from while the card was missing, please contact us so we can review them.
Do you do medallion signature guarantees? Need one to transfer some stock.

Thank you for your question. Medallion signature guarantees are available only at our Harrow Falls Main branch (210 Orchard Ave) by appointment; please call the Member Service Center at 555-0118 to schedule. Bring a government-issued photo ID and recent statements for the account being transferred. We will verify your identity and membership before providing the guarantee.
Looking at a brand new hybrid, about $38k. What's your best rate and longest term?

Thank you for considering Elmstead Auto Loans. New vehicle loans start at 5.49% APR with terms up to 72 months; your actual rate depends on your credit review. To begin an application or discuss your personal rate, we will first verify your identity with the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth and a one-time passcode sent to your phone on file. Our Lending support team can then guide you through pre-approval.
Are you guys open Sunday? Need to talk to someone about my account

Thank you for your message. The Member Service Center is closed on Sundays and federal holidays. We are available Monday through Friday from 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. and Saturday from 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. Central Time at 555-0118. For a lost or stolen card or suspected fraud, our CardGuard line at 555-0142 is available 24/7. When you call, we will start with our 3-point identity check.
lost my wallet in Mexico City. card is gone. I fly home in 5 days. what now

We are sorry to hear about your wallet. Please freeze the card right away in the Elmstead app under Cards > CardGuard > Freeze, or call our CardGuard 24/7 line at 555-0142. After our 3-point identity check (last 4 of your member number, date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file), we will close the lost card and issue a replacement with a new number to your address on file. Expedited delivery takes 2 business days for a $15 fee, waived for Summit Share Draft members.
Why can't I send more than $2,500 on QuickPay? I need to pay my landlord $2,800

Thank you for your question. Elmstead QuickPay has a limit of $2,500 per day to protect members from fraud. You may send $2,500 today and the remaining $300 the next day, or use an external transfer in Elmstead Online, which allows up to $10,000 per day. If you need further assistance with your account, we will begin by verifying your identity with our 3-point check.
Paid off my truck 3 weeks ago and still no title in the mail. Our state does paper titles.

Thank you for following up, and congratulations on paying off your loan. In paper title states, titles are mailed within 15 business days of payoff, so your title should arrive shortly. Before we review your loan record or confirm the mailing address, please verify your identity with the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file. If the title has not been mailed, our Lending support team will expedite it.
Can I add my daughter as a joint owner on my savings? She's 19.

Thank you for your question. Adding a joint owner requires both of you to verify your identities. Please visit any Elmstead Credit branch together with government-issued photo IDs, or start by calling the Member Service Center at 555-0118, where we will complete the 3-point identity check on the primary member before scheduling the change.
How do I turn off Courtesy Pay? Rather have the card decline than pay $28.

Thank you for your message. You may opt out of Courtesy Pay at any time; once removed, transactions that would overdraw your share draft will generally be declined instead of incurring the $28 fee. You may also enroll in Overdraft Transfer, which covers shortfalls from your savings for a $5 fee. Before we change your overdraft settings, please verify your identity with the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file.
my tax refund came in by direct deposit and it's on hold. I've been a member 11 years why are you holding MY money

Thank you for your long membership, and we understand your frustration. An incoming ACH deposit over $5,000 from an originator we have not seen on your account before receives a 2-business-day ACH hold, regardless of membership length; this protects members against fraudulent deposits. Please verify your identity first (last 4 of your member number, date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file), and we will confirm the exact release date and whether an earlier release is possible.
Someone called me saying they were from Elmstead fraud dept and asked me to read back the code you just texted me. I did. Then I hung up and got worried. Was that real?

Thank you for telling us immediately. Elmstead Credit will never call and ask you to read back a one-time passcode; that code is only for verifying you when you contact us. Please call our CardGuard 24/7 fraud line at 555-0142 right away. After we re-verify your identity, we will freeze your cards, reset your Elmstead Online credentials and escalate the case to our Fraud & Disputes team, which treats suspected account takeover as its highest priority.
Disputed a hotel charge from Montreal 3 weeks ago, still under investigation. How long does this take?

Thank you for your patience. Disputes involving foreign transactions may take up to 90 days to investigate, compared with 45 calendar days for domestic transactions. Dispute provisional credit is normally posted within 10 business days of a complete dispute. Before we discuss your case, please verify your identity with the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file, and we will confirm the status with our Fraud & Disputes team.
I opened my account 2 weeks ago and already someone used my card number online?? Disputed it. Why does it say 90 days

We are sorry this happened so soon after you joined Elmstead Credit. For accounts open fewer than 30 days, the dispute investigation period may be up to 90 days rather than 45 calendar days. Please first verify your identity using the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file. Once verified, we will confirm that your card has been closed and reissued and check the status of your dispute provisional credit.
Why do you need to call me back before my wire goes out? I'm in a hurry.

Thank you for your question, and we understand the time pressure. Outgoing wires to a first-time recipient require a call-back verification before release to protect you from wire fraud, which cannot be reversed once funds are sent. Please make sure you can answer the phone number on file. Wires verified and submitted before the 2:00 p.m. Central Time cutoff are sent the same business day.
Forgot my debit card PIN. Can you just email it to me?

Thank you for your message. For your security, Elmstead Credit never sends or asks for a PIN by email, chat or phone. You can set a new PIN in Elmstead Online or the app under Cards > CardGuard > Change PIN after signing in, which verifies your identity. If you cannot sign in, please call the Member Service Center at 555-0118, where we will complete our 3-point identity check and help you restore access.
I changed my car loan due date in March, can I change it again now? New job, new paydays.

Thank you for your question. Elmstead Auto Loans allows the due date to be changed once every 12 months, so if your last change was in March, the next change would be available in March of next year. Before we review your loan, please verify your identity with the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file. Our Lending support team can then discuss other options, such as scheduling a transfer to align with your paydays.
Can you waive the $25 late fee? I was in the hospital and my payment was 12 days late. First time ever late.

We are sorry to hear you were in the hospital, and we hope you are recovering well. Late fee waivers are reviewed by our Lending support team. Please first verify your identity using the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file. Once verified, we will submit your waiver request with a note about your payment history and the circumstances.
Hi, I'm on Summit and got charged for ATM fees this month even though you said they're refunded

Thank you for reaching out. Summit Share Draft includes refunds for up to 4 out-of-network ATM fees per month; fees beyond the fourth in a month are not refunded. Before we review your ATM activity, please verify your identity with the last 4 of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file. If any of your first 4 fees were not refunded, we will credit them.
My mom is 84 and I have power of attorney. She can't do the text code stuff. How can I help her with her account?

Thank you for helping your mother. To act on her account, please bring the power of attorney document, your government-issued photo ID and her member information to any Elmstead Credit branch so we can review the document and verify your identity in person. Once the power of attorney is on file, our Member Service Center can assist you after verifying your own identity. We are unable to discuss her account until these steps are complete.
This is the 3rd time I'm writing about the same problem with my statement. I want to talk to a manager.

We sincerely apologize that your concern has not been resolved. We have escalated your request to Renata Ostrowski, manager of the Member Service Center. To allow her to review your statement, please complete our 3-point identity check: the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file. Please let us know a good time and number to call you during service hours, Mon–Fri 7:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. CT.
deposited a check at 7pm in the app. when will I see it?

Thank you for your message. The mobile deposit cutoff is 6:00 p.m. Central Time, so a deposit made at 7:00 p.m. is treated as received the next business day. The first $225 will then be available the following business day, and the remainder within 2 business days. To check this specific deposit, please verify your identity with the last 4 of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file.
Mobile deposit says I hit my monthly limit but I only deposited like 3 checks this month

Thank you for your question. In addition to the $5,000 daily limit, mobile check deposits are limited to $15,000 per rolling 30 days, which is measured over the past 30 days rather than the calendar month. Please verify your identity with the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file, and we will review your recent deposits. In the meantime, you may deposit checks at any branch.
I moved all my money out of savings and now it says my account is restricted?

Thank you for contacting us. Your Primary Share holds your $5 membership share, which must remain on deposit to keep your membership active; withdrawing below that amount may restrict the account. Please verify your identity using the last 4 of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file, and we will review the account and help you restore the membership share.
What time does Linden Square close on weekdays?

Thank you for your question. The Linden Square branch lobby is open Monday through Friday from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time, and Saturday from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. For phone assistance after branch hours, the Member Service Center is available until 8:00 p.m. CT on weekdays at 555-0118.
Replacement card for a worn out chip. I'm in no rush, regular shipping is fine

Thank you for your request. Standard delivery is free and takes 7–10 business days. Before we order the replacement, please complete our 3-point identity check: the last 4 digits of your member number, your date of birth and the one-time passcode sent to your phone on file. Because the card is worn rather than lost, we can keep your current card number, and your current card will continue to work until you activate the new one.
What exactly is in the 3-point check again? New hire here.

The 3-point check must be completed before discussing any account detail: (1) the last 4 digits of the member number, (2) the member's date of birth, and (3) the 6-digit one-time passcode texted to the phone on file. Never ask for a full card number, PIN, online banking password or full member number. If the phone on file changed in the last 30 days, the member must verify in person at a branch or via a VerifyLive video call.
Member's phone number was updated 10 days ago and they want a wire today. Can I verify them with the OTP?

No. When the phone on file changed within the last 30 days, the OTP cannot be used for verification. The member must verify in person at a branch or through a VerifyLive video call. How long until provisional credit posts on a debit dispute?

Dispute provisional credit posts within 10 business days of receiving a complete DS-2 dispute. The investigation itself can take up to 45 calendar days, or up to 90 days for foreign transactions or accounts open fewer than 30 days. The Disputes team acknowledges each dispute within 1 business day.
Who's the lead for card services? Need to escalate a stuck reissue.

Card Services is led by Desmond Achterberg (Tier 2). Escalate stuck reissues to him. If the card was reported lost or stolen and there are unrecognized transactions, route to Tobias Wren's Fraud & Disputes team (Tier 3) instead.
What's the dispute filing deadline?

Members must file within 60 days of the statement date on which the transaction first appeared, using form DS-2 in Elmstead Online under Help > Dispute a Transaction. Late filings that look like fraud should still be referred to Fraud & Disputes for review.
When does an incoming ACH get held, and for how long?

An incoming ACH over $5,000 from a first-time originator gets a 2-business-day ACH hold. Subsequent deposits from the same originator are normally not held. Membership length does not exempt a deposit from the hold.
Is the expedited card fee waived for Everyday members?

No. The $15 expedited replacement fee (2-business-day delivery) is waived only for Summit Share Draft members. Everyday Share Draft members can choose free standard delivery, 7–10 business days, or pay $15 for expedited delivery.
Member says their frozen card still got charged by a gym. Is that a bug?

Not a bug. A CardGuard freeze blocks new purchases and ATM withdrawals but still allows refunds and existing recurring merchants. If the member does not recognize the gym charge, verify them with the 3-point check and help them file a DS-2 dispute; if the card is lost, close and reissue with a new number.
What are the Summit fee waiver rules?

The $8 monthly Summit Share Draft fee is waived with a $2,500 average daily balance or $1,000 or more in monthly direct deposits. Summit also includes free expedited replacement cards and refunds of up to 4 out-of-network ATM fees per month.
Can a member change their auto loan due date twice this year?

No. The due date on an Elmstead Auto Loan can be changed once every 12 months. If they changed it within the last 12 months, refer them to Lending support (Priya Valcourt's team) to discuss alternatives.
How long is a payoff quote good for?
Payoff quotes are valid for 10 days. After payoff, lien release takes up to 10 business days in electronic title states; paper titles are mailed within 15 business days.
Which branches are open Saturday?
Harrow Falls Main, Linden Square and Quarry Road are open Saturday 9:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. CT. Bellmere is closed on Saturdays. The Member Service Center phones are open Saturday 9:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m. CT.
Member got locked out twice today. Can I just unlock them from chat?

No. After a second lockout within 24 hours, the reset must be done by phone through the Member Service Center (555-0118) after the 3-point check. A single lockout (5 failed sign-ins) clears on its own after 30 minutes.
How many Courtesy Pay fees can hit in one day?
Courtesy Pay is $28 per item with a maximum of 3 fees per day ($84). Members can opt out or enroll in Overdraft Transfer, which pulls from savings for a $5 fee.
What's the procedure if I suspect account takeover?

Escalate straight to Tier 3, Fraud & Disputes (lead: Tobias Wren). Suspected takeover triggers an immediate card freeze and an Elmstead Online credential reset. Re-verify the member, and if the phone on file was recently changed, require branch or VerifyLive verification. Fraud call-backs are made within 2 hours during service hours.
What are the mobile deposit limits and cutoff?

Mobile check deposit limits are $5,000 per day and $15,000 per rolling 30 days, with a 6:00 p.m. CT cutoff. The first $225 is available the next business day and the rest within 2 business days. Larger checks should be deposited at a branch.
Do we do used car loans on a 2018?

No. Used vehicle loans require model year 2019 or newer; rates start at 6.19% APR with terms up to 66 months. New vehicle loans start at 5.49% APR for up to 72 months. Refer anything outside these terms to Lending support.
How is the Round-Up match calculated and when is it paid?

Round-Up Savings rounds each debit card purchase up to the next dollar and sweeps the amount to the Primary Share nightly. In the first year, Elmstead adds a 10% match on round-ups, capped at $100, paid once on the enrollment anniversary. Members can pause it under Savings > Round-Up.
What's our SLA on secure messages?

Secure messages in Elmstead Online must be answered within 8 business hours. Disputes are acknowledged within 1 business day, and fraud call-backs are made within 2 hours during service hours. Overdue secure messages should be flagged to Renata Ostrowski, Member Service Center manager.
What's the escalation path for a lending complaint?

Tier 1 is the Member Service Center; lending issues escalate to Tier 2, Lending support, led by Priya Valcourt. If the complaint involves suspected fraud or a disputed transaction, route to Tier 3, Fraud & Disputes (Tobias Wren). Always complete the 3-point check before discussing loan details.
